_why: Reviewed findings of `pnpm audit:pages`. One-directional: entries come out as pages are fixed, they do not go in without the owner's review (docs/page-consistency.md, 'How consistency is enforced'). The script reports stale entries so they get deleted.
_edges_why: The three listed routes are the Steam-palette /games library (L8: a native app inside the _site route tree, pending an owner decision, plan section 18 and the phase 5 report); its sticky top bar is that app's own. Phase 7 (2026-11-12) removed the entries for the deleted radial top bar and compose button. Any other edge-pinned layer is a design decision, not a styling detail: float it off the edge, make it in-flow, or hide it on html.ios-webkit.
